description: Removes a card from the wallet, with its tracked cap usage, bonus progress and yearly spending. Memberships and point values stay, even when the last card goes. Only when the user says they no longer have it or don't want it considered. It uses the wallet file on this computer, not the hosted earnrate connector's wallet.

cardId.description: The card id from search_cards, e.g. chase-sapphire-preferred.

name: remove_card
title: Remove a card
